messages:
maya: Heads-up: found a flaky Android repro with Retrofit/OkHttp where uploads double-send when auth refresh + retries happen. Repro in the kotlin-samples upload flow.
tom: Yikes. Is this the non-repeatable RequestBody case?
maya: Exactly. We stream from ContentResolver (InputStream) and rely on Authenticator to refresh on 401. OkHttp will retry/follow redirect and the request body isn't rewindable, so we either get a second partial upload or a server error.
vik: Can you share client config?
maya: Default + our authenticator. snippet:
```kotlin
val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .followRedirects(true)
  .writeTimeout(0, TimeUnit.SECONDS) // oops default no-timeout
  .authenticator(myAuth)
  .build()
```
maya: Turns out writeTimeout=0 caused hangs on some devices when write stalls, and retryOnConnectionFailure + authenticator made the replay behavior worse.
tom: Short-term fixes: 1) set finite timeouts, 2) disable retryOnConnectionFailure for upload endpoints, 3) make body repeatable (buffer to temp file or byte[]).
vik: For Kotlin sample we added a helper to write stream to cache file and create a FileRequestBody. Also added a runtime warning if an authenticator is present and the request body implements a OneShot marker.
maya: Longer-term: recommend resumable/chunked uploads in the SDK and update quickstart docs. Also add a lint check to flag InputStreamRequestBody usage when building a client with an authenticator.
ci-bot: Created issue #4012: "android-kotlin-sdk: avoid duplicate streaming uploads with Authenticator + OkHttp retries" https://github.com/redwood-inference/android-samples/issues/4012 :robot_face:
tom: Nice. Can we also add an integration test in android-samples that simulates connection reset + 401 to assert a single upload attempt?
maya: Yep, adding an instrumented test and a sample toggle (useTempFile=true). Will draft PR and tag @tom @vik for review. Thanks :thumbsup:
